The accounts pages are titled "Mind", following the desktop app's rename. The page title had been lowercase "minds" while every other surface said "Minds".

The hardcoded installer link the download page falls back to when the update feed is unreachable still names a "Minds" build, and stays that way until a renamed build is promoted to stable.

Drops a comment warning against importing `psycopg2.errors` explicitly, which the newly-added typeshed stubs make untrue.

The web client's nav bar, the accounts tab title, the privacy policy, terms of service, and code of conduct say Mind, as do the account emails SuperTokens sends.
